name: Gore Bike Wear Power Lady Tights Short + - Women's Black/White, XXL
description: If you're looking add another ride short to your rotation without spending your grocery money for a month, look to the Gore Bike Wear Power Lady Tights Short. Still part of the brand's upper tier of kit, the Power Lady comes with a straightforward design ready to accompany you on training rides after work and longer weekend excursions. As you push the pace and tackle more challenging roads, the Power Lady's supportive blend of nylon and elastane fibers will provide a stable fit while consistently drawing moisture away from your skin. With slightly cooler conditions in mind, Gore also added a windproof panel to the front of its plush Power Women chamois as well. Though it isn't a cold-weather short, this feature gives the Power Lady the ability to keep you warmer when you tuck into a shady descent near sunset and spend the next several miles growing chillier in the cool air.
